subject: M3 Survival loop: mining, drops, crafting, containers
description: Measured vanilla surface: 1,585 recipe files across 21 types (shaped 733, shapeless 323, stonecutting 319, smelting 73, crafting_transmute 33, blasting 25, smithing_trim 18, bannerduplicate 16, smithing_transform 12, campfire 9, smoking 9, crafting_dye 6, plus 8 single-count specials), 1,355 loot tables (1,113 block loot), 1,688 advancements (1,562 recipe unlock), 43 enchantments, 40 mob effects, 51 damage types. Today: hardness data is baked into manifest.json but referenced nowhere in src/ (every block breaks in one click, bedrock included), no drops, no crafting, no containers, no hunger/air/XP, game mode is ignored (src/menu.ts:12,572,945 and src/main.ts:326-337). Work: mining time from hardness + tool tier + enchantment, official destroy_stage_0..9 crack overlay, correct loot-table drops, item drop entities with pickup, crafting table + 2x2 + recipe book UI with the 29 recipe-book sprites, furnace/blasting/smoking/campfire, chest/barrel/shulker/ender chest screens using generic_54.png, hunger+saturation, air bubbles, XP and the experience bar, game modes actually wired to the menu, difficulty, death/respawn with beds.
